items.title: Så kan Sverige användas för att finansiera kärnvapen
items.title_en: How Sweden can be used to finance nuclear weapons
items.summary: Sweden's financial watchdog says crypto-assets and illegal financial networks pose the biggest risk of Iran and North Korea dodging sanctions via Sweden.

items.title: Uppgifter: Tonåringar silvertejpade man i jakt på kryptovaluta
items.title_en: Reports: teenagers duct-taped a man in hunt for cryptocurrency
items.summary: Three teenagers have been arrested in Lund on suspicion of kidnapping after allegedly tying up a local man with duct tape to rob him of crypto.

items.title: Kryptojätten i ny kontrovers – erbjöd tjänster i Europa utan licens
items.title_en: Crypto giant in new controversy: offered services in Europe without a licence
items.summary: Binance is under investigation for allegedly offering services in Europe without the licence required under the EU's new crypto rules.

items.title: Här är riskerna för finansiering av spridning av massförstörelsevapen störst
items.title_en: Here is where the risk of financing proliferation of weapons of mass destruction is highest
items.summary: Finansinspektionen's new risk assessment finds that financing of weapons of mass destruction is most likely through illegal financial activity and crypto-assets.

items.title: Krypto-jätten rundar reglerna i Europa: Riskerar att kastas ut
items.title_en: Crypto giant skirts the rules in Europe and risks being thrown out
items.summary: Binance said it would leave Europe, but customers are still trading, and EU financial authorities now want to know how.

items.title: GreenMerc kutter 4,8 millioner i året – Northcrypto går med overskudd
items.title_en: GreenMerc cuts SEK 4.8 million a year as Northcrypto turns a profit
items.summary: GreenMerc is cutting costs by SEK 4.8 million a year while Northcrypto turns a profit, with spending redirected to the banking offer Trijo One.

items.title: Pangstart for nytt kryptofond
items.title_en: Flying start for new crypto fund
items.summary: Joakim Hannisdahl's new crypto fund, built on a model that did well in backtesting, is up 39 percent since it launched in August.

items.title: Yhteisöllisyys ja teknologia kiehtovat kryptovaluuttoihin sijoittaneita – kryptotapahtumassa iloittiin bitcoinin uudesta nousurallista
items.title_en: Community and technology draw crypto investors: bitcoin's new rally celebrated at crypto event
items.summary: At a Finnish crypto event, investors described community and technology as what draws them to crypto, as bitcoin rallied again.

items.title: Coinmotion og K33 inngår nordisk kryptosamarbeid om institusjonell handel
items.title_en: Coinmotion and K33 strike Nordic crypto partnership on institutional trading
items.summary: Finnish broker Coinmotion has picked Norway's K33 to execute large trades, a partnership between two MiCA-licensed Nordic firms.

items.title: Safello åpner for at andre selskaper kan tilby kryptokjøp
items.title_en: Safello opens up so other companies can offer crypto purchases
items.summary: Sweden's Safello is testing a setup that lets companies without their own crypto business offer crypto purchases under Safello's MiCA licence.

items.title: NBX inngår avtale med Tieto om betalingskort for stablecoins
items.title_en: NBX signs deal with Tieto for stablecoin payment card
items.summary: NBX has signed with Tieto Banktech for a payment card that lets customers spend stablecoins in everyday purchases.

items.title: Kollaps for kryptobørs
items.title_en: Collapse for crypto exchange Firi
items.summary: Norwegian exchange Firi earned NOK 135 million in 2024 but posted a NOK 44 million loss in the first half of this year.

items.title: Slår et slag for stablecoins
items.title_en: Making the case for stablecoins
items.summary: Valour's Nordic head Johanna Belitz argues stablecoins can make cross-border payments much faster and cheaper.

items.title: NBX mer enn doblet tapet i halvåret da MiCA-lisensen kom
items.title_en: NBX more than doubled its half-year loss as the MiCA licence arrived
items.summary: NBX won its MiCA licence in the first half of 2026, but revenue fell 45 percent and its after-tax loss grew to NOK 16.6 million.

items.title: Norway Wants to Ban Bitcoin Mining. The Miners Already Left | Rachel Geyer, EBEA
items.title_en: Norway wants to ban bitcoin mining. The miners already left
items.summary: In a talk for Bitcoinpolitisk Institutt in Oslo, Rachel Geyer of the European Bitcoin Energy Association argues Norway's proposed mining ban targets a problem the country doesn't have.

items.title: GreenMerc trekker MiCA-klage og bruker Northcryptos lisens i Sverige
items.title_en: GreenMerc drops MiCA appeal and uses Northcrypto's licence in Sweden
items.summary: GreenMerc has dropped its MiCA appeal for Ijort Invest and will serve Swedish Trijo customers under Finnish Northcrypto's licence.

items.title: To tilsyn vil ikke si om kryptodistribusjon krever egen tillatelse
items.title_en: Two regulators won't say whether crypto distribution needs its own licence
items.summary: Neither ESMA nor Sweden's Finansinspektionen will say whether distributing crypto services under your own brand needs its own MiCA licence.

items.title: DNB tester tokeniserte innskudd i kroner med europeiske banker
items.title_en: DNB tests tokenised krone deposits with European banks
items.summary: DNB has joined CBMT, where European banks test tokenised bank deposits, adding the Norwegian krone to the test environment.

items.title: Firi tar opp kampen om 1,1 millioner svenske kryptoeiere
items.title_en: Firi takes on the fight for 1.1 million Swedish crypto owners
items.summary: Firi launches in Sweden this week, entering a market where about 1.1 million people already own crypto.

items.title: Hilbert finansierer utlån med innskudd på blokkjeden
items.title_en: Hilbert funds lending with on-chain deposits
items.summary: Hilbert Finance is taking stablecoin deposits on-chain and lending them out through a partnership with Ember Protocol.

items.title: Kvarn avviser at Goobit-avtalen er agentforhold eller outsourcing
items.title_en: Kvarn denies the Goobit deal is an agency or outsourcing arrangement
items.summary: Kvarn Capital argues its partnership with Sweden's Goobit falls outside MiCA's ban on agents and its outsourcing rules.

items.title: Finske Kvarn leier ut MiCA-tillatelsen sin til nordiske partnere
items.title_en: Finnish Kvarn rents out its MiCA licence to Nordic partners
items.summary: Finland's Kvarn Capital lets Nordic companies sell crypto services under its MiCA licence, with Goobit as the first named client.

items.title: Goobit lanserer sparing i bitcoin og gull på finsk lisens
items.title_en: Goobit launches bitcoin and gold savings on a Finnish licence
items.summary: After being refused by Sweden's Finansinspektionen, Goobit is launching Futureproof, a bitcoin and gold savings platform, under Finnish Kvarn Capital's MiCA licence.

items.title: Bitcoin-utvinning og norsk kraft på seminar i Oslo
items.title_en: Bitcoin mining and Norwegian power at Oslo seminar
items.summary: Bitcoinpolitisk Institutt is gathering researchers, industry and politicians in Oslo for a free seminar on bitcoin mining and Norwegian power.

items.title: H100-styrelederen vil ha flere oppkjøp i bitcoinbransjen
items.title_en: H100 chair wants more acquisitions in the bitcoin industry
items.summary: Sander Andersen of H100 Group says bitcoin companies worth under a billion dollars need to buy each other, because standing still is the biggest risk.

items.title: Blockchain på tech-scenen og på dagsorden i Stockholm
items.title_en: Blockchain on the tech scene and on the agenda in Stockholm
items.summary: Tokenisation at Blockchain Sweden and the final of the Blockathon hackathon put blockchain on the agenda in Stockholm this week.

items.title: BTCX blir megler, og Goobits rapporterte inntekter faller
items.title_en: BTCX becomes a broker, and Goobit's reported revenue falls
items.summary: Goobit is switching BTCX from proprietary trading to brokerage, citing MiCA, which cuts reported revenue but not gross profit.

items.title: Nytt nederlag for Valuno i kampen om MiCA-lisens
items.title_en: New defeat for Valuno in the fight for a MiCA licence
items.summary: Valuno company QB Europe has lost its appeal against the MiCA refusal in Sweden, but keeps operating through licensed partners.

items.title: Crypto-asset service providers in Finland must be authorised in the EU
items.summary: Finland's FIN-FSA reminds firms that crypto-asset service providers serving Finland must hold an EU (MiCA) authorisation.
